brief: The canvas displays a retro, text-based terminal console set against a dark background. The simulated output text glows with a subtle amber color. The environment is interactive; the viewer must input commands to progress the unfolding detective story. As the narrative progresses and significant evidence is revealed, the displayed text periodically undergoes a glitch effect, causing a momentary flicker of visual corruption that adds suspense to the detective experience.

statement: This sketch creates a retro-style detective terminal interface with a dark background and glowing amber text. The environment simulates an interactive investigation where users can input commands to progress the story. The system displays evolving case information and periodically triggers visual glitch effects that corrupt the display to create suspense. The terminal automatically generates new investigative clues and responses, while maintaining the illusion of an active detective work environment that responds dynamically to user interaction through a simple command interface.
